back_story: Sonny Forelli ran the Forelli family from Liberty City, and Tommy Vercetti once did his dirty work. Fifteen years later Tommy came back richer and more dangerous than ever — and Sonny, the jealous old don, sent a crew to Vice City to collect what was never his. On the rooftop helipad of the Vercetti Estate, the man who always made others bleed met the end he had coming.

curation.zh: 弗雷利家族的教父，汤米·维赛迪曾经的老大。当汤米带着满身财富和危险回到罪恶都市，忌妒的桑尼派人来收账——他习惯让别人流血，最终在维赛迪庄园的屋顶直升坪迎来自己的结局。
curation.en: The jealous don who sent a crew to collect from Tommy — and met his end on the Vercetti Estate helipad.
